```{r global-opts, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# PCA vs NMF benchmark on a single AUCell pathway-score matrix.
# Goal: on the SAME AUCell matrix, compare PCA and NMF as low-dimensional
# decompositions across reconstruction, component structure, graph modularity,
# reference-label agreement, and cluster compactness/separation.
# NOTE: this evaluates clustering geometry + reference agreement only; it does
# NOT establish biological superiority of either method.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Matrix)
  library(Seurat)
  library(RcppML)
  library(igraph)
  library(cluster)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})
```

```{r parameters}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PARAMETERS — edit to suit your data / compute budget
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SEURAT_OBJ      <- MG.recluster.obj
ASSAY           <- "AUCell"
SLOT            <- "data"

REFERENCE_LABEL <- "state_anno"      # column in obj@meta.data used as reference

# Subsampling / feature selection (to bound memory & runtime)
MAX_CELLS       <- 5000              # NA or Inf to keep all cells
TOP_FEATURES    <- 2000              # NA or Inf to keep all (after zero-var removal)

# Decomposition grids (compared at the SAME component counts)
PCA_K_LIST      <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)
NMF_RANK_LIST   <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)

# Clustering grids (identical for both methods)
K_PARAM_LIST    <- c(10, 20, 30)
RESOLUTION_LIST <- c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0)
CLUSTER_ALGO    <- 1                 # Seurat FindClusters: 1 = original Louvain

# NMF settings (RcppML backend)
NMF_NRUN        <- 10                # random inits; consensus cophenetic needs > 1
NMF_SEED        <- 123
NMF_TOL         <- 1e-4              # RcppML convergence tolerance
NMF_MAXIT       <- 100               # RcppML max iterations
NMF_L1          <- 0                 # optional L1 sparsity penalty (0 = none)
NMF_DO_MINMAX   <- FALSE             # optional per-feature min-max scaling of NMF input
COPH_MAX_CELLS  <- 1500              # subsample cells for consensus/cophenetic (O(n^2))

# PCA settings
PCA_CENTER      <- TRUE
PCA_SCALE       <- TRUE

# Reproducibility & misc
SEED            <- 42
SIL_MAX_CELLS   <- 3000              # subsample for silhouette/DBI distance (O(n^2))
OUT_PREFIX      <- "AUCell_PCA_NMF"

METHOD_COLOURS  <- c(PCA = "#1E88E5", NMF = "#E53935")
```

```{r dependencies}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fail early with a clear message if required packages are missing.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_dependencies <- function() {
  need <- c("Matrix", "Seurat", "RcppML", "igraph", "cluster",
            "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "patchwork", "scales")
  miss <- need[!vapply(need, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(miss) > 0)
    stop("Missing required package(s): ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         "\nInstall them before running this benchmark.", call. = FALSE)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r matrix-preparation}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract AUCell assay as a features x cells matrix.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
extract_assay_matrix <- function(seurat_obj, assay = ASSAY, slot = SLOT) {
  stopifnot(assay %in% names(seurat_obj@assays))
  mat <- tryCatch(
    Seurat::GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = assay, layer = slot),
    error = function(e) Seurat::GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = assay, slot = slot)
  )
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  # Ensure features x cells
  if (ncol(mat) != length(colnames(seurat_obj)) &&
      nrow(mat) == length(colnames(seurat_obj))) {
    mat <- t(mat)
  }
  cat(sprintf("[extract] %s/%s : %d features x %d cells\n",
              assay, slot, nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))
  mat
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subsample cells, drop zero-variance features, keep top-variance features.
# Returns a features x cells matrix with stable row/col names.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
prepare_benchmark_matrix <- function(mat,
                                     max_cells    = MAX_CELLS,
                                     top_features = TOP_FEATURES,
                                     seed         = SEED) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # subsample cells
  if (is.finite(max_cells) && ncol(mat) > max_cells) {
    keep <- sample(colnames(mat), max_cells)
    mat  <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    cat(sprintf("[prepare] subsampled cells -> %d\n", ncol(mat)))
  }

  # drop zero-variance features
  fvar  <- matrixStats_rowVars(mat)
  nzv   <- fvar > .Machine$double.eps
  if (any(!nzv))
    cat(sprintf("[prepare] removed %d zero-variance features\n", sum(!nzv)))
  mat   <- mat[nzv, , drop = FALSE]
  fvar  <- fvar[nzv]

  # keep top-variance features
  if (is.finite(top_features) && nrow(mat) > top_features) {
    keep <- order(fvar, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_features)]
    mat  <- mat[sort(keep), , drop = FALSE]
    cat(sprintf("[prepare] kept top %d variance features\n", nrow(mat)))
  }

  cat(sprintf("[prepare] final matrix: %d features x %d cells\n",
              nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))
  mat
}

# Lightweight row variances (avoids a matrixStats dependency)
matrixStats_rowVars <- function(m) {
  mu <- rowMeans(m)
  rowSums((m - mu)^2) / (ncol(m) - 1)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull the reference label for the retained cells; clear error if absent.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_reference_label <- function(seurat_obj, cells, label = REFERENCE_LABEL) {
  if (!label %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data))
    stop(sprintf("Reference label '%s' not found in obj@meta.data. Available: %s",
                 label, paste(colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data), collapse = ", ")),
         call. = FALSE)
  ref <- seurat_obj@meta.data[cells, label]
  ref <- as.factor(as.character(ref))
  names(ref) <- cells
  ref
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inputs for each method (control variable: same source matrix).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
prepare_pca_input <- function(mat_feat_by_cell) {
  # PCA operates on cells x features; centering/scaling handled by prcomp.
  t(mat_feat_by_cell)
}

prepare_nmf_input <- function(mat_feat_by_cell, do_minmax = NMF_DO_MINMAX) {
  V  <- as.matrix(mat_feat_by_cell)            # features x cells
  mn <- min(V)
  if (mn < 0) {                                # shift to non-negative
    V <- V - mn
    cat(sprintf("[nmf-input] negative values detected; shifted by %.4g\n", -mn))
  }
  if (do_minmax) {                             # optional per-feature min-max
    rmin <- apply(V, 1, min); rmax <- apply(V, 1, max)
    rng  <- rmax - rmin; rng[rng == 0] <- 1
    V <- (V - rmin) / rng
    cat("[nmf-input] applied per-feature min-max scaling\n")
  }
  V
}
```

```{r metric-helpers}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generic numeric helpers used by both decomposition and clustering metrics.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
.frob <- function(x) sqrt(sum(x^2))

frv <- function(X, Xhat) sum((X - Xhat)^2) / sum(X^2)   # residual variance fraction
reconstruction_error <- function(X, Xhat) .frob(X - Xhat)

# Hoyer sparsity of a vector in [0,1] (1 = maximally sparse)
hoyer_sparsity <- function(v) {
  v <- abs(v); n <- length(v)
  if (n <= 1) return(NA_real_)
  s2 <- sqrt(sum(v^2)); if (s2 == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (sqrt(n) - sum(v) / s2) / (sqrt(n) - 1)
}
# Mean Hoyer sparsity across the columns of a matrix
matrix_sparsity <- function(M) mean(apply(M, 2, hoyer_sparsity), na.rm = TRUE)

# Mean absolute off-diagonal correlation among components (columns of M)
component_redundancy <- function(M) {
  if (ncol(M) < 2) return(0)
  C  <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(M))
  od <- C[upper.tri(C)]
  mean(abs(od), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Adjusted Rand index (base R; no external dependency)
adjusted_rand_index <- function(a, b) {
  tab <- table(a, b)
  comb2 <- function(x) sum(choose(x, 2))
  n  <- sum(tab)
  idx     <- comb2(tab)
  exp_idx <- comb2(rowSums(tab)) * comb2(colSums(tab)) / choose(n, 2)
  max_idx <- (comb2(rowSums(tab)) + comb2(colSums(tab))) / 2
  if (max_idx == exp_idx) return(0)
  (idx - exp_idx) / (max_idx - exp_idx)
}

# Cluster purity against a reference labelling
cluster_purity <- function(clusters, reference) {
  tab <- table(clusters, reference)
  sum(apply(tab, 1, max)) / sum(tab)
}

# Davies-Bouldin index (lower = better; base R)
davies_bouldin <- function(emb, clusters) {
  cl <- as.integer(factor(clusters)); ks <- sort(unique(cl)); K <- length(ks)
  if (K < 2) return(NA_real_)
  cent <- t(vapply(ks, function(k) colMeans(emb[cl == k, , drop = FALSE]),
                   numeric(ncol(emb))))
  S <- vapply(ks, function(k) {
    pts <- emb[cl == k, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(pts) <= 1) return(0)
    mean(sqrt(rowSums(sweep(pts, 2, colMeans(pts))^2)))
  }, numeric(1))
  db <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(K)) {
    rij <- vapply(setdiff(seq_len(K), i), function(j) {
      mij <- sqrt(sum((cent[i, ] - cent[j, ])^2))
      if (mij == 0) 0 else (S[i] + S[j]) / mij
    }, numeric(1))
    db <- db + max(rij)
  }
  db / K
}

# Mean / median silhouette in an embedding space (subsamples for O(n^2) cost)
silhouette_summary <- function(emb, clusters, max_cells = SIL_MAX_CELLS, seed = SEED) {
  cl <- as.integer(factor(clusters))
  if (length(unique(cl)) < 2) return(c(mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_))
  set.seed(seed)
  if (nrow(emb) > max_cells) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(emb)), max_cells)
    emb <- emb[idx, , drop = FALSE]; cl <- cl[idx]
    if (length(unique(cl)) < 2) return(c(mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_))
  }
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(cl, stats::dist(emb))
  if (is.na(sil[1])) return(c(mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_))
  w <- sil[, "sil_width"]
  c(mean = mean(w), median = stats::median(w))
}
```

```{r pca-benchmark}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run PCA once (up to max k); reconstruct and score each k.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_pca <- function(cells_by_feat, max_k, center = PCA_CENTER, scale = PCA_SCALE,
                    seed = SEED) {
  set.seed(seed)
  prcomp(cells_by_feat, center = center, scale. = scale, rank. = max_k)
}

# Decomposition metrics + cells x PCs embedding for a given k
pca_decomp_metrics <- function(pca, cells_by_feat, k) {
  var_all <- pca$sdev^2
  expl    <- cumsum(var_all) / sum(var_all)
  # work in the centered/scaled space PCA operates on
  Xc   <- scale(cells_by_feat, center = pca$center, scale = pca$scale)
  sc   <- pca$x[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE]
  load <- pca$rotation[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE]
  Xhat <- sc %*% t(load)

  list(
    metrics = data.frame(
      method               = "PCA",
      n_components         = k,
      FRV                  = 1 - expl[k],
      reconstruction_error = reconstruction_error(Xc, Xhat),
      explained_signal     = expl[k],
      component_sparsity   = matrix_sparsity(load),         # loading sparsity
      coefficient_sparsity = NA_real_,                      # PCA: not applicable
      component_redundancy = component_redundancy(sc),      # PC-score redundancy (~0)
      cophenetic           = NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    embedding = sc                                          # cells x PCs
  )
}
```

```{r nmf-benchmark}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NMF via RcppML.  RcppML factorises  V ~= W diag(d) H  and returns a list with
# $w (features x k), $d (length k), $h (k x cells); it drops dimnames, so we
# re-attach them. We do nrun random inits, keep the best by reconstruction
# error, and build a consensus matrix across runs to get a cophenetic
# coefficient (RcppML has no built-in cophenetic).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Robustly pull a field from an RcppML fit (list in v0.3.x; S4 in newer versions)
.pick <- function(fit, nm) {
  v <- tryCatch(fit[[nm]], error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(v)) v <- tryCatch(methods::slot(fit, nm), error = function(e) NULL)
  v
}

# Single RcppML run -> normalised parts list(W, H, d) with dimnames restored
run_nmf <- function(feat_by_cell, rank, seed = NMF_SEED,
                    tol = NMF_TOL, maxit = NMF_MAXIT, L1 = NMF_L1) {
  fit <- RcppML::nmf(feat_by_cell, k = rank, seed = seed, tol = tol,
                     maxit = maxit, L1 = c(L1, L1), verbose = FALSE)
  W <- .pick(fit, "w"); H <- .pick(fit, "h"); d <- .pick(fit, "d")
  if (is.null(W) || is.null(H))
    stop("Could not extract W/H from RcppML fit (unexpected API).", call. = FALSE)
  if (is.null(d)) d <- rep(1, ncol(W))
  rownames(W) <- rownames(feat_by_cell)
  colnames(H) <- colnames(feat_by_cell)
  list(W = W, H = H, d = d)
}

# Consensus cophenetic coefficient across runs (cells subsampled for O(n^2) cost)
nmf_cophenetic <- function(parts, n_cells, max_cells = COPH_MAX_CELLS, seed = NMF_SEED) {
  if (length(parts) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  set.seed(seed)
  idx <- if (n_cells > max_cells) sort(sample.int(n_cells, max_cells)) else seq_len(n_cells)
  m    <- length(idx)
  conn <- matrix(0, m, m)
  for (p in parts) {
    Huse <- p$d * p$H[, idx, drop = FALSE]              # scale rows by d
    a    <- max.col(t(Huse), ties.method = "first")     # dominant component / cell
    conn <- conn + outer(a, a, `==`)
  }
  consensus <- conn / length(parts)
  dco <- stats::as.dist(1 - consensus)
  hc  <- stats::hclust(dco, method = "average")
  stats::cor(as.vector(dco), as.vector(stats::cophenetic(hc)))
}

# Multiple inits -> best fit (lowest reconstruction error) + cophenetic
run_nmf_multi <- function(feat_by_cell, rank, nrun = NMF_NRUN, seed = NMF_SEED) {
  set.seed(seed)
  seeds <- sample.int(1e6, nrun)
  parts <- lapply(seeds, function(s) run_nmf(feat_by_cell, rank, seed = s))
  Vm    <- as.matrix(feat_by_cell)
  errs  <- vapply(parts, function(p)
    reconstruction_error(Vm, sweep(p$W, 2, p$d, "*") %*% p$H), numeric(1))
  list(best       = parts[[which.min(errs)]],
       cophenetic = nmf_cophenetic(parts, ncol(feat_by_cell), seed = seed),
       n_runs     = nrun,
       errors     = errs)
}

# Decomposition metrics + cells x components embedding from a multi-run result
nmf_decomp_metrics <- function(nmf_res, V, rank) {
  p    <- nmf_res$best
  Wd   <- sweep(p$W, 2, p$d, "*")     # W diag(d)
  Huse <- p$d * p$H                   # diag(d) H
  Xhat <- Wd %*% p$H                  # = W diag(d) H
  f    <- frv(V, Xhat)

  list(
    metrics = data.frame(
      method               = "NMF",
      n_components         = rank,
      FRV                  = f,
      reconstruction_error = reconstruction_error(V, Xhat),
      explained_signal     = 1 - f,
      component_sparsity   = matrix_sparsity(p$W),        # basis sparsity
      coefficient_sparsity = matrix_sparsity(t(p$H)),     # coefficient sparsity (per cell)
      component_redundancy = component_redundancy(t(Huse)),
      cophenetic           = nmf_res$cophenetic,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    embedding = t(Huse)                                   # cells x NMF components
  )
}
```

```{r decomposition-runner}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run both decompositions across their component grids.
# Returns: long decomposition-metric df + a named list of embeddings.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_decomposition_benchmark <- function(mat_feat_by_cell,
                                        pca_k_list    = PCA_K_LIST,
                                        nmf_rank_list = NMF_RANK_LIST,
                                        seed          = SEED) {
  embeddings <- list()
  rows       <- list()

  # --- PCA ---
  cat("\n[PCA] running ...\n")
  pca_in  <- prepare_pca_input(mat_feat_by_cell)
  pca_fit <- run_pca(pca_in, max_k = max(pca_k_list), seed = seed)
  for (k in pca_k_list) {
    res <- pca_decomp_metrics(pca_fit, pca_in, k)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]]        <- res$metrics
    embeddings[[paste0("PCA|", k)]] <- res$embedding
    cat(sprintf("  PCA k=%-3d  FRV=%.3f\n", k, res$metrics$FRV))
  }

  # --- NMF (RcppML, nrun random inits) ---
  cat("\n[NMF] running (RcppML, nrun =", NMF_NRUN, ") ...\n")
  V <- prepare_nmf_input(mat_feat_by_cell)
  for (r in nmf_rank_list) {
    nr  <- run_nmf_multi(V, rank = r)
    res <- nmf_decomp_metrics(nr, V, r)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]]         <- res$metrics
    embeddings[[paste0("NMF|", r)]]  <- res$embedding
    cat(sprintf("  NMF rank=%-3d  FRV=%.3f  coph=%.3f\n",
                r, res$metrics$FRV, res$metrics$cophenetic))
  }

  list(decomposition = dplyr::bind_rows(rows), embeddings = embeddings)
}
```

```{r clustering-runner}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One clustering on an embedding: same algorithm for PCA and NMF.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cluster_once <- function(embedding, k_param, resolution,
                         algorithm = CLUSTER_ALGO, seed = SEED) {
  nn  <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(embedding, k.param = k_param, verbose = FALSE)
  snn <- nn$snn
  cl  <- Seurat::FindClusters(snn, resolution = resolution, algorithm = algorithm,
                              random.seed = seed, verbose = FALSE)
  memb <- if (is.data.frame(cl)) cl[[1]] else cl
  memb <- factor(as.character(memb))
  names(memb) <- rownames(embedding)
  list(clusters = memb, snn = snn)
}

# Graph modularity for a membership on an SNN graph
graph_modularity <- function(snn, memb) {
  g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
    methods::as(snn, "CsparseMatrix"), mode = "undirected",
    weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  igraph::modularity(g, membership = as.integer(factor(memb)))
}

# Full quality metric set for one clustering result
clustering_quality <- function(embedding, memb, snn, reference) {
  ref   <- reference[rownames(embedding)]
  sizes <- as.integer(table(memb))
  sil   <- silhouette_summary(embedding, memb)
  data.frame(
    ARI             = adjusted_rand_index(memb, ref),
    purity          = cluster_purity(memb, ref),
    modularity      = graph_modularity(snn, memb),
    mean_silhouette = unname(sil["mean"]),
    median_silhouette = unname(sil["median"]),
    DBI             = davies_bouldin(embedding, memb),
    n_clusters      = length(unique(memb)),
    min_cluster_size    = min(sizes),
    median_cluster_size = stats::median(sizes),
    max_cluster_size    = max(sizes),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clustering benchmark over every embedding x k_param x resolution.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_clustering_benchmark <- function(embeddings, reference,
                                     k_param_list    = K_PARAM_LIST,
                                     resolution_list = RESOLUTION_LIST,
                                     seed            = SEED) {
  rows <- list()
  for (key in names(embeddings)) {
    parts  <- strsplit(key, "\\|")[[1]]
    method <- parts[1]; ncomp <- as.integer(parts[2])
    emb    <- embeddings[[key]]
    for (kp in k_param_list) {
      for (res in resolution_list) {
        cc <- tryCatch(cluster_once(emb, kp, res, seed = seed),
                       error = function(e) { warning(e$message); NULL })
        if (is.null(cc)) next
        q  <- clustering_quality(emb, cc$clusters, cc$snn, reference)
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- cbind(
          data.frame(method = method, n_components = ncomp,
                     k_param = kp, resolution = res,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE), q)
        cat(sprintf("  %s n=%-3d k=%-3d res=%.2f  ARI=%.3f  nclust=%d\n",
                    method, ncomp, kp, res, q$ARI, q$n_clusters))
      }
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}
```

```{r assemble-long}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Unified long-format table (decomposition + clustering metrics).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
assemble_all_metrics_long <- function(decomp_df, clust_df) {
  dec_long <- decomp_df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(FRV, reconstruction_error, explained_signal,
                                 component_sparsity, coefficient_sparsity,
                                 component_redundancy, cophenetic),
                        names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(k_param = NA_integer_, resolution = NA_real_,
                  metric_type = "decomposition")

  clu_long <- clust_df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(ARI, purity, modularity, mean_silhouette,
                                 median_silhouette, DBI, n_clusters,
                                 min_cluster_size, median_cluster_size,
                                 max_cluster_size),
                        names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(metric_type = "clustering")

  dplyr::bind_rows(dec_long, clu_long) %>%
    dplyr::select(method, n_components, k_param, resolution,
                  metric_type, metric, value)
}
```

```{r plots}
.bench_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid      = element_blank(),
          panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# FRV vs number of components (lower = better)
plot_frv <- function(decomp_df) {
  ggplot(decomp_df, aes(n_components, FRV, color = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = "Residual variance fraction (FRV) vs components",
         subtitle = "Lower is better",
         x = "Components / rank", y = "FRV") +
    .bench_theme()
}

# ARI across k_param, faceted by resolution
plot_ari_facet <- function(clust_df) {
  ggplot(clust_df, aes(factor(k_param), ARI, color = method, group = method)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ resolution, nrow = 1, labeller = label_both) +
    scale_color_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = "ARI vs k_param (faceted by resolution)",
         subtitle = "Mean over component counts; higher is better",
         x = "k_param", y = "ARI") +
    .bench_theme()
}

# Modularity barplot (best parameter per method/component shown via max)
plot_modularity_bar <- function(clust_df) {
  d <- clust_df %>% dplyr::group_by(method, n_components) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(modularity = max(modularity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(d, aes(factor(n_components), modularity, fill = method)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = "Graph modularity (best per component count)",
         subtitle = "Higher is better",
         x = "Components / rank", y = "Modularity") +
    .bench_theme()
}

# Silhouette distribution (per method)
plot_silhouette_dist <- function(clust_df) {
  ggplot(clust_df, aes(method, mean_silhouette, fill = method)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = "Mean silhouette distribution",
         subtitle = "Across all parameter combinations; higher is better",
         x = NULL, y = "Mean silhouette") +
    .bench_theme() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# DBI barplot (lower = better)
plot_dbi_bar <- function(clust_df) {
  d <- clust_df %>% dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(DBI = stats::median(DBI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(d, aes(method, DBI, fill = method)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, name = "Method") +
    labs(title = "Davies-Bouldin index (median)",
         subtitle = "Lower is better", x = NULL, y = "DBI") +
    .bench_theme() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# Combined summary panel
# plot_summary_panel <- function(decomp_df, clust_df) {
#   (plot_frv(decomp_df) | plot_ari_facet(clust_df)) /
#     (plot_modularity_bar(clust_df) | plot_silhouette_dist(clust_df) | plot_dbi_bar(clust_df)) +
#     patchwork::plot_annotation(
#       title = "AUCell matrix: PCA vs NMF low-dimensional benchmark",
#       theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15)))
# }
plot_summary_panel <- function(decomp_df, clust_df) {
  top_row <- (plot_frv(decomp_df) | plot_ari_facet(clust_df)) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))

  bottom_row <- plot_modularity_bar(clust_df) |
    plot_silhouette_dist(clust_df) |
    plot_dbi_bar(clust_df)

  (top_row / bottom_row) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "AUCell matrix: PCA vs NMF low-dimensional benchmark",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15))
    )
}

```

```{r parameter-selection}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Composite ranking. Each metric is min-max normalised across all rows and
# oriented so that higher = better; FRV/DBI are inverted; n_clusters is
# penalised for being extreme relative to the reference's class count.
# This produces a RANKING, not a verdict of absolute superiority.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
select_best_parameters <- function(clust_df, decomp_df, reference,
                                    weights = c(FRV = 1, ARI = 1, silhouette = 1,
                                                DBI = 1, modularity = 1,
                                                ncluster = 0.5)) {
  norm01 <- function(x) {
    r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (diff(r) == 0) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
    (x - r[1]) / diff(r)
  }
  ref_k <- length(unique(reference))

  df <- clust_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(decomp_df, method, n_components, FRV),
                     by = c("method", "n_components")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      s_FRV        = 1 - norm01(FRV),
      s_ARI        = norm01(ARI),
      s_silhouette = norm01(mean_silhouette),
      s_DBI        = 1 - norm01(DBI),
      s_modularity = norm01(modularity),
      s_ncluster   = 1 - norm01(abs(n_clusters - ref_k)),
      composite =
        (weights["FRV"]        * s_FRV +
         weights["ARI"]        * s_ARI +
         weights["silhouette"] * s_silhouette +
         weights["DBI"]        * s_DBI +
         weights["modularity"] * s_modularity +
         weights["ncluster"]   * s_ncluster) / sum(weights)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(composite))

  df
}

# Cautious, metric-scoped summary statement
summarise_outcome <- function(ranking) {
  best   <- ranking[1, ]
  by_m   <- ranking %>% dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_composite = mean(composite, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_composite))
  leader <- by_m$method[1]
  msg <- sprintf(
    paste0("Under the tested AUCell matrix and parameter grid, %s showed the ",
           "higher composite decomposition/clustering-geometry score ",
           "(mean composite: %s). Best single configuration: %s with %d ",
           "components, k_param=%d, resolution=%.2f (composite=%.3f). ",
           "This reflects clustering geometry and reference-label agreement on ",
           "the tested grid only and does not establish biological superiority."),
    leader,
    paste(sprintf("%s=%.3f", by_m$method, by_m$mean_composite), collapse = ", "),
    best$method, best$n_components, best$k_param, best$resolution, best$composite)
  cat("\n", strwrap(msg, width = 90), sep = "\n")
  invisible(by_m)
}
```

```{r master-runner}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# End-to-end driver. Writes the three CSVs and returns all objects.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_aucell_pca_nmf_benchmark <- function(seurat_obj = SEURAT_OBJ,
                                         out_prefix = OUT_PREFIX) {
  check_dependencies()
  set.seed(SEED)

  raw  <- extract_assay_matrix(seurat_obj, ASSAY, SLOT)
  mat  <- prepare_benchmark_matrix(raw)
  ref  <- get_reference_label(seurat_obj, colnames(mat), REFERENCE_LABEL)

  dec  <- run_decomposition_benchmark(mat)
  clu  <- run_clustering_benchmark(dec$embeddings, ref)
  long <- assemble_all_metrics_long(dec$decomposition, clu)
  rank <- select_best_parameters(clu, dec$decomposition, ref)

  # --- write CSVs ---
  write.csv(dec$decomposition,
            paste0(out_prefix, "_decomposition_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(clu,
            paste0(out_prefix, "_clustering_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(long,
            paste0(out_prefix, "_all_metrics_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(rank,
            paste0(out_prefix, "_ranking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\n[write] CSVs written with prefix '%s'\n", out_prefix))

  list(matrix = mat, reference = ref, decomposition = dec$decomposition,
       embeddings = dec$embeddings, clustering = clu, long = long, ranking = rank)
}
```

```{r execute, fig.width=16, fig.height=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res <- run_aucell_pca_nmf_benchmark()

cat("\n--- Decomposition metrics ---\n");        print(res$decomposition)
cat("\n--- Clustering metrics (head) ---\n");     print(utils::head(res$clustering, 12))

# Plots
panel <- plot_summary_panel(res$decomposition, res$clustering)
print(panel)
ggsave(paste0(OUT_PREFIX, "_summary_panel.pdf"), panel,
       width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 150)

# Cautious, metric-scoped outcome statement + ranking head
summarise_outcome(res$ranking)
cat("\n--- Top configurations by composite score ---\n")
print(utils::head(res$ranking[, c("method","n_components","k_param","resolution",
                                  "ARI","mean_silhouette","DBI","modularity",
                                  "n_clusters","composite")], 10))
```
